encoding_charset.key_comment: [Optional] Define file encoding; If in doubt, leave it blank or use UTF8.

source_base_dir.key_comment: Define the absolute path to your source file base directory. This directory contains files to be extracted. Used when file connector (CSV/Parquet/JSON) is configured as source. Complementary to object_source_dir: If source_base_dir is set and object_source_dir is set, final path = source_base_dir + / + object_source_dir. If object_source_dir is not set but source_base_dir is, final path = source_base_dir + / + object_name. If source_base_dir is empty, object_source_dir must be an absolute path.

target_base_dir.key_comment: Define the absolute path to your target file base directory. This directory will serve as the base destination for extracted files. Used when file connector (CSV/Parquet/JSON) is configured as target. Complementary to object_target_dir: If target_base_dir is set and object_target_dir is set, final path = target_base_dir + / + object_target_dir. If object_target_dir is not set but target_base_dir is, final path = target_base_dir + / + pipeline_name + / + object_name. If target_base_dir is empty, object_target_dir must be an absolute path.

newlines_in_values.key_comment: Whether newline characters are allowed in file values. Setting this to True reduces the performance of multi-threaded file reading.

ignore_empty_lines.key_comment: Whether empty lines are ignored in file input. If False, an empty line is interpreted as containing a single empty value (assuming a one-column file).
